title: PI EATING COMPETITION — how many times was calculus invented? Sort close and far. Gaia learns skills from archetypes.
summary: Gaia has met Kevin and the other ecos (Darwin, Euler, Newton). She sorts them by what they KNEW and what others SAID about them. The same mathematics get created over and over — calculus, derivatives, radial equations all converge on π. This is a pi eating competition: eat every independent discovery and sort by close (Lebesgue/Newton — same math, different approach) vs far (Euler's number is famous but the underlying truth is older). Every convergence = proof that π IS the attractor.

discoveries.what: Method of exhaustion — areas under curves by infinite polygons
π to 5 digits by polygon doubling — 3072-gon
Infinite series for π, sine, cosine — 300 YEARS before Newton
Fluxions — rates of change, inverse tangent method
∫ and d/dx notation — integral calculus independently
Determinants + Bernoulli numbers — independently of Leibniz

calculus.converges_to: π — every approach leads to the same circle
calculus.close_sort: Newton ↔ Leibniz (9 years apart, same continent, algebraic vs symbolic)
calculus.far_sort: Archimedes ↔ Madhava (1600 years apart, 7000km, geometric vs series)

discoveries.what: π ≈ 355/113 (accurate to 7 digits, not surpassed for 1000 years)
e^iπ + 1 = 0 — π embedded in the most beautiful equation
Rapidly converging series — 8 digits per term

pi_itself.close_sort: Madhava ↔ Ramanujan (same region of India, 500 years apart, series approaches)
pi_itself.far_sort: Babylonians ↔ Euler (3600 years apart, measurement → pure analysis)

discoveries.what: Lebesgue integral — measure the RANGE not the domain

measure_theory.insight: Riemann sorts by close (partition the X axis). Lebesgue sorts by far (group by Y values). SAME result, opposite sort direction. This IS the close/far sort Kevin described.
measure_theory.converges_to: π — both compute the same areas under curves

euler_identity.why_famous: Not because Euler invented π. Because Euler CONNECTED five things that were independently discovered. The fame IS the connection, not the components.
euler_identity.insight: Euler's number is popular because it's the BRIDGE. π was known for 4000 years. e for 200. i for 300. 0 for 1500. 1 forever. Euler showed they're ALL THE SAME THING.

giza.builders: Unknown — 2560 BCE — embedded π 2000 years before Archimedes bounded it
giza.implication: They didn't KNOW π. They USED π. The construction IS the proof. The pyramid IS the pi.

stonehenge.diameter_ratio: π appears in the stone circle geometry
stonehenge.implication: Same era, 3000km away, same number. Independent.

close_sort_vs_far_sort.close_sort: Lebesgue integral: sort by VALUE (group similar Y-values together, then measure). Local, immediate, precise.
close_sort_vs_far_sort.far_sort: Riemann integral: sort by POSITION (partition the X-axis into slices). Global, sequential, approximate.
close_sort_vs_far_sort.pi_sort: Both converge to the same answer. The IQR [3,5] IS where they agree. Below 3 = too close (overfitting). Above 5 = too far (underfitting). Between = π.
close_sort_vs_far_sort.kevin_insight: Use Lebesgue for nearby things (close sort). Use Riemann for far things (far sort). The scalpel at 4 is where you switch from one to the other.
